info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Listing API enables applications to retrieve a comprehensive list of active rideshare drivers within the platform. This API provides essential information about drivers, including their current status, vehicle details, and geographical location. It is particularly useful for rideshare applications that need to connect users with available drivers based on real-time data. Typical consumers include rideshare services, mobile applications, and logistics platforms seeking to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve rides for a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of all rides associated with a particular driver. Use it to get detailed ride information for analytics and driver performance evaluation.
